The Chinese characters for Dean

As a transliteration, Dean is usually written 迪恩 (Dí ēn). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

迪
Dí
enlighten, guide
恩
ēn
grace, favor

Origin and meaning

Dean comes from English and means “valley, or church official”.

About the name Dean

A cool one-syllable choice popularised by the actor James Dean.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Dean as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “valley, or church official”, is part of the appeal.
